facts.text: I have adult siblings who haven't spoken in years.
I want to reconnect with my sibling and strengthen our relationship.
I have tried to find common ground with my sibling but we still can't seem to find it.
I feel guilt or resentment that might be lingering after years of not speaking to my sibling.
I find it hard to let go of guilt or resentment even after making progress reconnecting.
My sibling doesn't seem interested in reconnecting despite my efforts.
I find it hard to keep putting in energy without receiving any in return.
I don't have the energy to keep trying anymore.
It hurts too much for me to keep putting myself out there and getting no response.

keyphrases: not having energy to keep trying
